name: subject received overrides rejection body
spec: A subject saying the application was received/submitted ("We received your application", "Application submitted") → Confirmation, even when the body lists later statuses such as "Not selected — we will not be moving forward".

args.subject: We received your application
args.body: Not selected — we will not be moving forward.

name: thank you application but chose other candidates is rejection
spec: A mail titled "Thank you for your application" whose body says they chose other candidates is a Rejection.

args.subject: Thank you for your application
args.body: After reviewing, we chose other candidates for this role.

name: conditional HireVue and schedule call not invite
spec: Conditional sentences are not invites: a sentence with "if", "may", "might", "once", "upon", "should you", "will contact you", "will reach out", "potential fit" names a possible later step. "The next step may include a HireVue interview", ... "we will contact you to schedule an interview" do NOT make the mail an Assessment or Interview

args.subject: Application update
args.body: The next step may include a HireVue interview, and we will contact you to schedule an interview.

name: conditional HackerRank not assessment
spec: "If selected you will receive a HackerRank assessment" ... do NOT make the mail an Assessment or Interview

args.subject: Your application
args.body: If selected you will receive a HackerRank assessment.

name: draft saved and continue to apply is Other
spec: A mail that says a draft was saved / asks him to "continue to apply" / "complete and submit your job application" → Other.

args.subject: Complete and submit your job application
args.body: Your draft was saved. Continue to apply when ready.

name: company suffix removed and sender match
spec: The full company name (lower-cased; punctuation removed; Inc / LLC / Corp / Company / Group / Technologies / Labs … removed) counts when it appears as whole words in the sender or subject, or — only when the sender is an applicant-tracking system (greenhouse, myworkday/workday, lever.co, ashbyhq, smartrecruiters, icims, workable, oraclecloud, or an address containing talent / recruit / hire.) — in the body.

name: substring is not whole word match
spec: The full company name (lower-cased; punctuation removed; Inc / LLC / Corp / Company / Group / Technologies / Labs … removed) counts when it appears as whole words in the sender or subject, or — only when the sender is an applicant-tracking system (greenhouse, myworkday/workday, lever.co, ashbyhq, smartrecruiters, icims, workable, oraclecloud, or an address containing talent / recruit / hire.) — in the body.

name: ATS body company match
spec: The full company name (lower-cased; punctuation removed; Inc / LLC / Corp / Company / Group / Technologies / Labs … removed) counts when it appears as whole words in the sender or subject, or — only when the sender is an applicant-tracking system (greenhouse, myworkday/workday, lever.co, ashbyhq, smartrecruiters, icims, workable, oraclecloud, or an address containing talent / recruit / hire.) — in the body.

name: non-ATS body company ignored
spec: The full company name (lower-cased; punctuation removed; Inc / LLC / Corp / Company / Group / Technologies / Labs … removed) counts when it appears as whole words in the sender or subject, or — only when the sender is an applicant-tracking system (greenhouse, myworkday/workday, lever.co, ashbyhq, smartrecruiters, icims, workable, oraclecloud, or an address containing talent / recruit / hire.) — in the body.

name: Shortlisted row never matched
spec: Rows with status Shortlisted or Archived are never matched.

name: first word domain label match
spec: The first word of a multi-word company name counts alone only when ALL hold: it has ≥ 3 letters, it is not an ordinary English word (applied, base, human, major, dynamic …), no other company in the tracker starts with the same word, it appears in the sender or subject (never the body), and the sender is an applicant-tracking system or the word is a label of the sender's e-mail domain (e.g. "imc" in recruiting@imc.com).

name: ordinary first word does not match alone
spec: The first word of a multi-word company name counts alone only when ALL hold: it has ≥ 3 letters, it is not an ordinary English word (applied, base, human, major, dynamic …), no other company in the tracker starts with the same word, it appears in the sender or subject (never the body), and the sender is an applicant-tracking system or the word is a label of the sender's e-mail domain (e.g. "imc" in recruiting@imc.com).

name: shared first word does not match alone
spec: The first word of a multi-word company name counts alone only when ALL hold: it has ≥ 3 letters, it is not an ordinary English word (applied, base, human, major, dynamic …), no other company in the tracker starts with the same word, it appears in the sender or subject (never the body), and the sender is an applicant-tracking system or the word is a label of the sender's e-mail domain (e.g. "imc" in recruiting@imc.com).

name: title overlap picks science row
spec: Several rows match → the one sharing the most title words with the subject + body, words compared by their first five letters (Science = Scientist, Analyst = Analytics), ignoring intern / internship / summer / years / program; ties → the row applied most recently on or before the mail date; rows applied after the mail date rank last.

name: tie picks most recent before date and after-date ranks last
spec: Several rows match → the one sharing the most title words with the subject + body, words compared by their first five letters (Science = Scientist, Analyst = Analytics), ignoring intern / internship / summer / years / program; ties → the row applied most recently on or before the mail date; rows applied after the mail date rank last.

name: bulk non-ATS mail dropped
spec: A bulk mail (List-Unsubscribe / newsletter, m.bulk true) from a sender that is not an applicant-tracking system is dropped (returns None, nothing stored) — even when the sender name is the company.

name: bulk ATS mail not dropped
spec: With a Claude reader, Claude's verdict decides; the keyword rules are a filter.

name: reader raise with matched rejection stores Pending and keeps rows
spec: reader.read(m) may raise (credit balance too low, bad key, API down). Then the application rows never change (no status, last_email or action), not even for a rejection. If the rules matched an application or the sender is an applicant-tracking system, one row is stored with type "Pending", job_id "", reread true, rules_type = the rules' type; else nothing is stored. Returns None.

m.subject: Application update
m.body: Unfortunately, we are not moving forward.

name: reader raise with ATS sender but no rules match stores Pending
spec: If the rules matched an application or the sender is an applicant-tracking system, one row is stored with type "Pending", job_id "", reread true, rules_type = the rules' type; else nothing is stored. Returns None.

name: reader raise without match or ATS stores nothing
spec: reader.read(m) may raise (credit balance too low, bad key, API down). Then the application rows never change (no status, last_email or action), not even for a rejection. If the rules matched an application or the sender is an applicant-tracking system, one row is stored with type "Pending", job_id "", reread true, rules_type = the rules' type; else nothing is stored. Returns None.

name: fresh Claude rejection moves stage and keeps applied_on
spec: With a Claude reader, Claude's verdict decides; the keyword rules are a filter.

name: fresh Claude Assessment moves Applied to Assessment
spec: Claude's type moves the stage (Rejection → Rejected; Assessment → Assessment only from Applied).

name: Claude Assessment does not move Interview stage
spec: Assessment → Assessment only from Applied

name: reread old Assessment undo then Claude rejection
spec: Success → Claude's verdict applies fully like a fresh read: the row gets Claude's type and job_id; a stage move the old row made is undone (Assessment → back to Applied); then Claude's type moves the stage (Rejection → Rejected; Assessment → Assessment only from Applied). applied_on never changes.

name: reread old Assessment undo then Claude Assessment
spec: Success → Claude's verdict applies fully like a fresh read: the row gets Claude's type and job_id; a stage move the old row made is undone (Assessment → back to Applied); then Claude's type moves the stage (Rejection → Rejected; Assessment → Assessment only from Applied). applied_on never changes.

name: health oks returns ok no alert
spec: oks ≥ 1 → ok true, no alert.

name: health no reads state unchanged
spec: No reads (fails empty, oks 0) → state unchanged, no alert.

name: health first failure no alert yet
spec: No alert at 2 hours or less, whatever the cause.

name: health exactly two hours auth no alert
spec: No alert at 2 hours or less, whatever the cause.

name: health over two hours credit alert
spec: One alert when the failures have lasted MORE than 2 hours since `since`; never a second alert for the same outage; a new outage (after a good read) may alert again. No alert at 2 hours or less, whatever the cause.

name: health over two hours auth alert
spec: The alert body names the cause: "credit" when the error says "credit balance is too low", "auth" for an authentication / API-key error, else "error".

name: health over two hours generic error alert
spec: The alert body names the cause: "credit" when the error says "credit balance is too low", "auth" for an authentication / API-key error, else "error".

name: health never second alert same outage
spec: One alert when the failures have lasted MORE than 2 hours since `since`; never a second alert for the same outage; a new outage (after a good read) may alert again.

name: health new outage after good read may alert again
spec: One alert when the failures have lasted MORE than 2 hours since `since`; never a second alert for the same outage; a new outage (after a good read) may alert again.
